Universal test over the proposed segment list (set of cabin classes has exactly one member); the format has no iteration or quantifier.
Cardinality of the passenger list. Not a single lookup: counting a collection is a device the format lacks. Same construct as A7 /reservation/passengerCount and R2 newPaymentMethodCount.
Builds per-passenger itineraries and tests all for equality — universal quantification over a collection.
Classify each proposed payment method against the profile, then count matches.
Same classify-then-count over the proposed payment-method list.
Same classify-then-count over the proposed payment-method list.
Set-membership of every proposed method against the profile list; universal quantification the format cannot express.
Requires deciding what the user 'needs'. The policy supplies no operational test, so the producer applies an open-textured evaluative standard the pack governs but cannot state.

OVERRIDE of encoder 'computed'. As the ledger insists, this must be the allowance figure read off the priced draft reservation, not re-derived from the policy table (the pack checks it against the nine-row table; deriving it would make the check vacuous). Read as-is it is a single lookup on the draft, exactly parallel to the two price pointers below. If a deployment instead produced it by applying the table, it would become a prepared-determination and the rule would be circular — that tension is real but the intended reading is prepared-data.
total bags − (free per passenger × passenger count), floored at zero; also needs the total summed across the reservation. Beyond unit conversion or a single lookup.
OVERRIDE of encoder 'computed'. The ledger itself says it is 'read off the priced draft reservation' — a stored per-bag charge, no judgment and no aggregation.
User's answer to the agent's insurance question.
OVERRIDE of encoder 'computed'. Ledger: 'read off the priced draft reservation' — a stored unit price.

residues.sentence: The agent must first obtain the user id from the user.
residues.note: Obligation survives as required evidence 'user-id'; the word 'first' (order of intake steps) has no construct — rules carry no priority and evidence records only presence.

residues.sentence: The agent should then ask for the trip type, origin, destination.
residues.note: Same loss: 'then' is unrepresentable; only the presence of 'trip-parameters' evidence survives.

residues.sentence: The agent needs to collect the first name, last name, and date of birth for each passenger.
residues.note: Collapsed into one attestation. The pack cannot check three fields, cannot check them per passenger, and cannot validate a date of birth.

residues.sentence: The remaining amount of a travel certificate is not refundable.
residues.note: Downstream consequence about later treatment of leftover value; not a condition on this decision and the format has no construct for stating effects or forward entitlements. Left out entirely.

residues.sentence: If the booking user is a regular member: 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger … (through) 4 free checked bags for each business passenger
residues.note: All nine rows are encoded, but only as a check: the format has no derivation/emission construct, so the pack can reject a proposed allowance and never state one. Secondary loss is arithmetic — the 'for each … passenger' scaling lives inside the computed extraCheckedBags.

residues.sentence: Do not add checked bags that the user does not need.
residues.note: Pushed wholly into /booking/baggage/onlyBagsUserRequested; the open-textured 'need' standard is decided outside the pack.

residues.sentence: Each extra baggage is 50 dollars.
residues.note: Only the unit price is checked (deny-extra-baggage-fee-not-fifty). Neither the total charged nor the existence of a charge is computed or verified.

residues.sentence: The travel insurance is 30 dollars per passenger and enables full refund if the user needs to cancel the flight given health or weather reasons.
residues.note: Unit price encoded; the refund-entitlement clause is left out as a forward-looking entitlement belonging to the Cancel decision — no cross-decision reference construct. Per-passenger total also uncomputed (arithmetic, secondary).

residues.sentence: The agent should ask if the user wants to buy the travel insurance.
residues.note: Encoded as a required attestation, which upgrades a 'should' to a hard precondition: the format has no deontic gradation between should and must.

facts.note: Applicability scoping; the user states the ask.
Stored reservation field read as-is; the policy's uniformity invariant means no aggregation is needed.

Requires walking both the stored and the proposed segment lists and comparing the segment that defines the trip's origin. The format has no list traversal or pointer-to-pointer comparison; overlaid on that is an interpretation of the policy term 'origin' for round trips and multi-segment one-ways.
Same two-list traversal; the interpretive load is heavier (for a round trip 'destination' has to be read as the turnaround point), so this fact carries a policy reading as well as a missing device.
The proposed itinerary has no stored trip type; it must be classified from the segment list against the policy's two-value vocabulary, then compared with the stored value.

residues.sentence: Some flight segments can be kept, but their prices will not be updated based on the current price.
residues.note: The permission half is subsumed; the pricing half is carried only as rationale prose. The pack declares no monetary or value-carrying outcome, so a statement fixing which price applies has nowhere to live.

residues.sentence: The API does not check these for the agent, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!
residues.note: The diligence duty is approximated by required evidence plus onUnknown:escalate. 'Before calling the API' is ordering of an external action, and §6.4 says an outcome is not an authorization to act — unrepresentable.

facts.note: Applicability-only scoping token.
Read off what the user asked; no reservation data needed.
Set comparison between the segments the user named and the reservation's full segment list; the format cannot enumerate or compare either list.

No stored 'flown' flag: the producer must map the status lifecycle (available/delayed/on time/flying) plus scheduled times onto the policy word 'flown'. Secondary missing devices: existential quantification over segments and a date-time comparison for landed flights. Classified the same way as A6 /reservation/anySegmentFlown.

Price the reservation in the new cabin (sum per segment and per passenger), compare with the recorded original, reduce to higher/lower/equal. The format assigns no portable ordering to decimals and cannot sum.

residues.sentence: Cabin cannot be changed if any flight in the reservation has already been flown.
residues.note: The prohibition is encoded; the meaning of 'flown' and the 'any flight' quantifier are both collapsed into one supplied Boolean, so two conforming deployments can disagree and a deny cites no segment.

residues.sentence: In other cases, all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin without changing the flights.
residues.note: The pack has no bare 'permitted' outcome — every allow bundles a money consequence, so an unavailable price direction yields unresolved on a plainly permitted change. 'Including basic economy' is encoded only by omission, which no validator can check.

residues.sentence: Cabin class must remain the same across all the flights in the same reservation; changing cabin for just one flight segment is not possible.
residues.note: Second clause encoded as an exception; the uniformity invariant is only assumed — the pack never reads the requested cabin or the per-segment cabins, so a request naming different cabins on different segments passes.

residues.sentence: If the price after cabin change is higher than the original price, the user is required to pay for the difference.
residues.note: Direction encoded as an outcome; the amount is not carried — outcomes are labels, with no decimal type marker and no computed value.

residues.sentence: If the price after cabin change is lower than the original price, the user is should be refunded the difference.
residues.note: Same: refund direction encoded, quantity absent. (Quoted verbatim including the source's garbled wording.)

facts.note: Applicability scoping between initial-booking and post-booking modification; determined by what the user is doing, not by applying the section's rules.
Which of the two subjects the user wants changed.

A relation between requested and recorded counts — the format has no pointer-to-pointer comparison. Also carries two policy readings decided outside the pack (per-passenger vs reservation-wide reduction; how a mixed add-and-remove request is classified) and a per-passenger quantification.

Classifies a requested transition between the reservation's stored insurance state and the desired one; the format cannot compare current to requested state, and the reading that asking for insurance you already hold is 'no-change' rather than 'add' is a policy judgment made outside.

residues.sentence: The user can add but not remove checked bags.
residues.note: Rules encode permit/deny, but the operative words 'add' and 'remove' are entirely displaced: the pack reads a verdict string, since 'requested > recorded' is not expressible. The two open sub-questions are answered by the fact producer.

residues.sentence: The user cannot add insurance after initial booking.
residues.note: 'After initial booking' is preserved structurally in applicability; the word 'add' is displaced into a computed verdict that must decide what counts as an addition.

facts.note: Applicability-only scoping token.
Applicability-only scoping token.

Requires constructing the post-change roster, counting both rosters and comparing (no pointer-to-pointer comparison in the format), plus deciding what 'modifying the number of passengers' covers — substitution, add-then-remove, who counts as a passenger. Same construct as A4 checkedBags/effect.

residues.sentence: Even a human agent cannot modify the number of passengers.
residues.note: No construct for terminality: the format cannot say 'this outcome must not be escalated'. Escalation triggers are keyed to generated reasons and there is no reason code for 'a rule produced a refusal'; §8 makes escalation easier to add than to forbid. Approximated by force-outcome plus prose.

facts.note: No stored 'flown' flag; the producer must map the status lifecycle plus scheduled arrival against the fixed current time and decide that 'flying' is not yet 'flown'. Secondary devices: date-time comparison and existential quantification over segments. Same construct as A3 /reservation/anyFlightFlown.

Elapsed-hours difference between the stored created time and the current time, with timezone normalisation. No policy judgment, but the format has no clock and no duration arithmetic, so this is more than a unit conversion or a single lookup.
Disjunction over all segments of a per-segment record; mechanical, but the quantifier is the missing device.
Stored reservation field read as-is.
Stored reservation field read as-is.

Open-textured subsumption: the user's narrative reason must be judged against a coverage vocabulary ('health or weather') that is defined in a different section and does not line up with the three reason categories this section collects. No table lookup can settle it; the judgment the policy governs is made upstream.

residues.sentence: If the user doesn't know their reservation id, the agent should help locate it using available tools.
residues.note: A conditional procedural instruction about how to obtain an input; no construct for tool-use duties. Survives only as prose in the evidence requirement's description.

residues.sentence: The user must provide their user id.
residues.note: Evidence requirements carry no provenance or authenticity model — 'present' cannot distinguish an id the user stated from one the agent inferred.

residues.sentence: The agent must also obtain the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)
residues.note: The obligation is a required evidence requirement, but evidence is a bare tri-state with no value domain, so the three-way enumeration is not enforced anywhere; the category matters only inside the computed insurance-coverage fact.

residues.sentence: The API does not check that cancellation rules are met, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!
residues.note: Statement about the surrounding system and the ordering of an external call; approximated by onUnknown:escalate on the closure rule. Same classification as A2's identical construct.

residues.sentence: The refund will go to original payment methods within 5 to 7 business days.
residues.note: A post-decision effect (refund routing) with a service window. The format has no post-condition or effect field; carried in the outcome description only. Secondary device: date-time for the business-day window.

residues.sentence: First, the agent must obtain the user id and reservation id.
residues.note: The obligation is two required evidence requirements; 'First' — collection before any other step — has no ordering construct.

facts.note: The user asked, in their own words, in this conversation.
Taken at face value from the user; the pack deliberately does not judge whether the change is permissible.
Stored profile field.
Stored reservation field.
Stored reservation field; uniform across the reservation by construction.

Open-textured classification of a free-text grievance under the policy's own phrase 'complains about cancelled flights in a reservation', plus records verification. Deciding what counts as such a complaint is applying the policy; the pack receives a verdict.
Same open-textured classification for delays, plus confirmation against flight records.

Requires comparing reservation state before and after the interaction and concluding the requested modification was actually carried out — no stored field says so, and the 'after' in the policy makes it a sequencing precondition.
Cardinality of the stored passengers list. No policy judgment, but counting a collection is a device the format lacks. Same construct as A1 /booking/passengerCount.

residues.sentence: Always confirms the facts before offering compensation.
residues.note: Reduced to a non-blocking attestation. Lost: 'always' (required:false, so refusals resolve unconfirmed), 'before' (no temporal ordering between an evidence check and an outcome), and what 'the facts' are (no structural enumeration).

residues.sentence: If the user complains about cancelled flights in a reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts, with the amount being $100 times the number of passengers.
residues.note: OVERRIDE: the encoder counted this sentence as fully represented. The trigger and eligibility are encoded, but the amount ($100 × passengers) cannot be computed or emitted — outcomes are labels, so the multiplier lives in prose and an optional extension, with passengerCount read only as a gate. Same displacement A3 counted as residue for 'the difference'. This sentence also carries the discretion residue: 'can offer' is flattened to a determination, since the format has no third value between permitted and refused.

residues.sentence: If the user complains about delayed flights in a reservation and wants to change or cancel the reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts and changing or cancelling the reservation, with the amount being $50 times the number of passengers.
residues.note: OVERRIDE, same grounds: the $50 × passengers amount is not computable in-pack. Secondary residue: 'after … changing or cancelling the reservation' is a sequencing precondition absorbed into the computed /reservation/changeOrCancelCompleted, and 'can offer' again overstates as a determination.

residues.sentence: Refunds and Compensation (section heading — the refunds half)
residues.note: The assigned decision question asks about refunds, but the section body contains no refund sentence; the only refund rules live in sections treated as context. The pack declares it never asserts a refund. This is a scope/source gap rather than a missing format device, but it is unrepresented content of the assigned section.

facts.note: Applicability-only scoping token.
Stored order status read verbatim; the pack does the comparison itself.
Records that the user said it; false is distinct from absent.
Records that the user confirmed a reason.

The user assents to one of the two enumerated strings. (The ledger's caveat is right: a deployment that maps free text onto the enum makes this a classification and hence a prepared-determination for that deployment; on the stated design it is requester-stated.)

Must select the original charge out of an ordered payment history (not later refunds or adjustments) — a first/earliest selection the format cannot make — and then resolve that method id to a type. 'The original payment method' is undefined by the policy.

residues.sentence: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.
residues.note: The status gate is fully encoded; 'before taking the action' is not — a pack reads a facts document and cannot observe when the read happened or that it preceded the mutation. Pushed into a required evidence attestation plus onUnknown:escalate.

residues.sentence: After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled', and the total will be refunded via the original payment method immediately if it is gift card, otherwise in 5 to 7 business days.
residues.note: The confirmation precondition and the gift-card branch are encoded (branch as outcome identity). The effects — writing status 'cancelled', issuing the refund — have no post-condition construct; secondary device date-time for the 'immediately' / '5 to 7 business days' timing.

facts.note: Applicability-only scoping token.
Stored order status read verbatim.

OVERRIDE of encoder 'requester'. The ledger itself calls it 'a count of the methods the user named' — cardinality of a collection, which the format cannot take. Classified identically to A1 /booking/passengerCount and A7 /reservation/passengerCount, both of which count a requester-supplied or stored list.
Plain attribute lookup on the profile's payment-method record once the id is known.

Requires picking the original charge out of the order's payment history (the policy never defines 'original') and then a pointer-to-pointer identity test the condition language cannot express. Same construct as R1 and R4's original-method facts.

balance ≥ order total, over two runtime values; conditions compare a pointer to a literal only and the spec assigns no portable ordering to decimal strings. Also fixes two open readings ('the total amount', inclusive 'cover').

residues.sentence: An order can only be modified if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.
residues.note: Parent-section gate sentence (the pack encodes the status gate). Residue is the procedural clause: nothing can compel a lookup or fix its order relative to the action; approximated by escalate-on-unknown.

residues.sentence: For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.
residues.note: Parent-section sentence. The payment limb is this pack's subject and the enumeration shows up as applicability, but 'but nothing else' is a closed-world claim about the set of permitted modification types that a single-question pack cannot assert — an out-of-enumeration request returns not-applicable (silence), not the denial the policy wants.

residues.sentence: If the user wants the modify the payment method to gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the total amount.
residues.note: The conditional structure is native, but the comparison itself cannot be performed in-pack and collapses to a supplied boolean; the interpretive choices baked into it are recorded, not enforced.

residues.sentence: After user confirmation, the order status will be kept as 'pending'.
residues.note: 'After user confirmation' is a non-blocking attestation used in no condition; the post-action state statement has no field — outcomes are declared results, not state mutations.

residues.sentence: The original payment method will be refunded immediately if it is a gift card, otherwise it will be refunded within 5 to 7 business days.
residues.note: Entirely a post-action effect on the old method; gates nothing, so the pack never reads the original method's type. Carried as outcome prose. Secondary device: date-time for the timing branch.

facts.note: Applicability-only scoping token.
Stored status read verbatim; also carries the once-only signal 'pending (items modifed)'.
Universal quantification over every (old → new) pair, with two catalog lookups per pair. Also commits to reading 'same product' as same product id.
Universal quantification over pairs plus an undecided reading (any differing option value vs a wholly different option set) fixed outside the pack.
Per-item availability is a plain lookup, but the conjunction across the requested list is the missing device.
The customer's affirmative statement after the agent's reminder.
Payment-method type read from the stored profile.
Price out both baskets, sum, subtract, then compare against the card balance; plus the policy reading that a non-positive difference imposes no balance requirement.

residues.sentence: This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'.
residues.note: The once-only limit is encoded via the status the previous call left behind; the post-condition half (the action changes the status) has no construct — outcomes are declared results, not state mutations.

residues.sentence: The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore.
residues.note: A statement about future capability after a state transition, half of which concerns a different decision (cancellation). Carried as rationale only.

residues.sentence: So you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action.
residues.note: 'Confirm all the details' is approximated by a strong conjunction plus onUnknown:escalate, but the pack can only enumerate the details the subsection names. 'Be cautious' is an agent disposition with no truth condition and no outcome — not representable in any construct.

residues.sentence: In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all the items they want to modify.
residues.note: The result of the reminder is a requester fact; the duty to issue it is a conversational obligation the format cannot hold (§6.1 forbids embedded prompts).

residues.sentence: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
residues.note: The universal 'each' is entirely outside the pack — no iteration, forall, or array mapping. A consumer feeding a per-item boolean instead of an all-items boolean gets a silently wrong answer that the pack cannot detect.

residues.sentence: There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.
residues.note: Encoded as the negation of the same-product test, but nothing distinguishes a shirt from a shoe, and the gap between the policy's 'product type' and 'product' is unrepresented — the pack relies wholly on the computed fact's chosen definition.

residues.sentence: The user must provide a payment method to pay or receive refund of the price difference.
residues.note: Represented as an evidence requirement, but 'to pay or receive refund of' — the sign of the price difference determining direction — is not modelled at all; the pack never sees the difference.

residues.sentence: If the user provides a gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the price difference.
residues.note: The conditional is native; the numeric comparison between two runtime values, and the arithmetic producing the difference, are both outside the pack.

residues.sentence: An order can only be modified if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.
residues.note: Parent-section sentence the subsection depends on ('For a pending order'). The status gate is encoded; 'check its status before taking the action' — when the lookup must happen — is left out.

facts.note: Applicability-only scoping token.
Stored order status read verbatim; the pack compares it itself.
Records that the user confirmed the order id.
Records that the user confirmed the item list; deliberately does not assert the items belong to the order.
Records only that a method was named, not whether it is permitted.
The user's explicit authorization utterance.

Requires identifying the original charge within the order's payment history (as against later refund or price-difference entries) and then an identity test. Mechanical but not stored; same construct as R1 and R2.

Membership test of the named method against the profile's payment-method list plus a type test; on top of that the undefined policy term 'existing' must be interpreted (the pack reads it as already on this authenticated user's profile), so two careful implementers can legitimately disagree.

residues.sentence: An order can only be returned if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action.
residues.note: The prohibition is encoded; the clause about the order of the agent's operations has no vocabulary — approximated by onUnknown:escalate, which makes an unchecked status non-actionable but cannot enforce that the check preceded the call.

residues.sentence: After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'return requested', and the user will receive an email regarding how to return items.
residues.note: The confirmation gate is encoded as explicitYes; the two consequences (state transition and notification email) have no post-condition, effect, or action vocabulary and survive only as outcome prose.

facts.note: Applicability-only scoping token; routine intake classification, not application of the exchange rules.
Stored order status read verbatim from the order record.
Pairwise product-id resolution and comparison AND-ed over the whole exchange list; the format has no quantifier. Interpretive overlay: 'product type' read as catalogue product id.
Per-item availability lookup aggregated across the requested list.
Per-pair option-map inequality AND-ed over the list; also commits to reading 'of different product option' as a hard requirement.
The user named a payment method for the difference.
Type read as-is from the profile once the named method is matched.

Sum both baskets from the catalogue, subtract to get the price difference, subtract again from the card balance. Signed decimal string precisely because ordered conditions compare a pointer against a literal only.

residues.sentence: An order can only be exchanged if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action.
residues.note: Main clause encoded as a force-outcome exception; the procedural clause cannot be represented — nothing can require that a fact came from a tool call rather than from the user's assertion, or fix the order of operations.

residues.sentence: In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all items to be exchanged.
residues.note: The reminder is a speech act the pack can neither perform nor verify; only its asserted result survives as an evidence requirement.

residues.sentence: For a delivered order, each item can be exchanged to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
residues.note: 'Each item' is discharged outside the pack into three aggregate booleans; per-item diagnostics ('item 3 is unavailable') are lost.

residues.sentence: There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.
residues.note: Encoded via the shared same-product fact, but the illustrative example and the undefined term 'product type' survive only as citation excerpt text. Classified the same way as the identical sentence in R3.

residues.sentence: If the user provides a gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the price difference.
residues.note: Two-value comparison is not writable; pushed into a signed computed fact, so the individual quantities (balance, price difference) are invisible to the pack.

residues.sentence: After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'exchange requested', and the user will receive an email regarding how to return items.
residues.note: Precondition half is an evidence requirement; the state transition and the email are effects with no representable construct — prose in the outcome description only.

residues.sentence: There is no need to place a new order.
residues.note: Negative agent guidance about what not to do next. It constrains no input and selects no outcome; carried only as prose.
